messages.subject: Lunchtime seminar: PD 57AC and trial witness statements — 7 May
messages.plaintextBody:
Please join us on 7 May at 1pm (Room 4 / Teams) for a practical session on Practice Direction 57AC and the dos and don'ts of trial witness statements, with a review of recent costs sanctions. Sandwiches provided for those attending in person. 1 hour CPD.

RSVP to Learning.

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
DX 138760 Cheapside | +44 (0)20 7946 0991
www.whitfieldcarter.com
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
